name: Outcast 1.1
description: Outcast 1.1 is a singleplayer third-person action-adventure game, an enhanced edition of 1999's Outcast, recompiled from the original source code and improved to run smoothly on today's computers.

eax.problem: This is the 2014 Outcast 1.1, not the original 1999 Outcast, and it has no EAX.

notes: The original 1999 Outcast supports EAX, and GOG includes it as a separate download among the extras.
